title: KALLAX shelf unit
description: KALLAX shelf unit, white, 715/8x715/8" Shelving unit or room divider – the KALLAX series adapts to taste, space, needs and budget. Smooth surfaces and rounded corners give a feel of quality and you can personalize the shelving unit with inserts and boxes.
features: Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
Two people are needed to assemble this furniture.
Coordinates well with pieces of furniture in the LACK series that have the same timeless expression and material as KALLAX.
materialAndCare: Particle- and fiberboard with honeycomb paper filling (100% recycled paper), Printed and embossed acrylic paint, Paper foil, Plastic edging
